# unit_distance_upper_bound

For a finite set P of n points in the Euclidean plane, the number of
unordered pairs of points at distance exactly 1 is O(n^{4/3}). This is the
Spencer–Szemerédi–Trotter upper bound (1984) for Erdős's 1946 unit-distance
problem, and it remains the best known asymptotic bound.
